request.query: Finsupp weight monotone in weights, bounded by degree times constant when every weight is bounded above

items.name: Finsupp.le_weight
items.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} (w : σ → ℕ) {s : σ}, w s ≠ 0 → ∀ (f : σ →₀ ℕ), f s ≤ (Finsupp.weight w) f

items.name: Finsupp.le_degree
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid R] [inst_1 : PartialOrder R] [CanonicallyOrderedAdd R] (s : σ)
  (f : σ →₀ R), f s ≤ Finsupp.degree f

items.name: Finsupp.degree
items.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_4} → [inst : AddCommMonoid R] → (σ →₀ R) →+ R

items.name: Finsupp.support_mono
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_3} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : PartialOrder α] [CanonicallyOrderedAdd α]
  {f g : ι →₀ α}, f ≤ g → f.support ⊆ g.support

items.name: Finsupp.support_monotone
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_3} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : PartialOrder α] [CanonicallyOrderedAdd α],
  Monotone Finsupp.support

items.name: Finsupp.weight_apply
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → M) [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : Module R M] (f : σ →₀ R), (Finsupp.weight w) f = f.sum fun i c => c • w i

items.name: Finsupp.degree_apply
items.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_4} [inst : AddCommMonoid R] (d : σ →₀ R), Finsupp.degree d = ∑ i ∈ d.support, d i

items.name: MvPolynomial.le_weightedTotalDegree
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {σ : Type u_3} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : SemilatticeSup M] [inst_3 : OrderBot M] (w : σ → M) {φ : MvPolynomial σ R} {d : σ →₀ ℕ},
  d ∈ φ.support → (Finsupp.weight w) d ≤ MvPolynomial.weightedTotalDegree w φ

items.name: Finsupp.le_weight_of_ne_zero'
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : PartialOrder M] [IsOrderedAddMonoid M]
  [CanonicallyOrderedAdd M] (w : σ → M) {s : σ} {f : σ →₀ ℕ}, f s ≠ 0 → w s ≤ (Finsupp.weight w) f

items.name: Finsupp.finite_of_nat_weight_le
items.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [Finite σ] (w : σ → ℕ), (∀ (x : σ), w x ≠ 0) → ∀ (n : ℕ), {d | (Finsupp.weight w) d ≤ n}.Finite
